intent: Repair the Camera Bench unboxing card so it plays the owner-supplied Sony video it promises.

visual_evidence.scope_reason: A mobile disclosure promises video but currently reveals only text.
visual_evidence.comparison: The existing still disclosure must become a visible, controllable player without changing the Camera Bench composition.

brief.visitor: A mobile visitor exploring Esteban's camera setup.
brief.promise: The unboxing control opens the actual Sony Alpha 7 IV video.
brief.primary_action: Tap Open the unboxing / Abrir el unboxing.
brief.friction: The current control promises video but expands to explanatory text only.

kpi.decision_rule: retain when the player is present, controllable and does not regress mobile layout

concept.idea: Keep the existing camera-card reveal and place the real video inside its disclosure.
concept.brand_reason: It makes the camera bench truthful without adding a second visual system.
concept.interaction: Native details opens; visitor uses native video controls.
concept.visible_response: The still becomes the poster for an exposed video player.
concept.direct_path: The rest of the homepage remains reachable without playing video.
concept.alternatives: Do not use a misleading label or a new visual scene.

story.consequence: The real Sony clip is available to play
story.next_step: Continue to the working method or packages

content.visible: Existing unboxing title, image and action label
content.optional_html: Native details with player and one factual line
content.linked_depth: Sony source link remains in camera specifications

references.borrow: Existing camera-kit native disclosure and native video patterns
references.avoid: Autoplaying audio, a fake player, or claims beyond the supplied footage

components.local_reason: This is Esteban-specific owner media in an existing brand-specific component.

verification.motion: manual playback; reduced motion does not auto-start
verification.conversion_boundary: not applicable; this is an informational player

learning.baseline_value: 0 player sources in Camera Bench disclosure
learning.hypothesis: Matching the control promise to a real player removes a misleading interaction.
learning.decision_rule: retain if the player renders and works on phone without overflow
